subject: Overturning of Roe v. Wade
overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan interviewed ACLU Massachusetts Field Director Laura Rótolo about the Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. Rótolo discussed state-level legal protections, healthcare provider security, and action steps for supporting reproductive rights.

items.title: Medford Family Network Gala Announcement
items.summary: Danielle Balocca announced the return of the Medford Family Network Gala scheduled for September 10th at Wright's Pond.

items.title: Guest Introduction
items.summary: ACLU Massachusetts Field Director Laura Rótolo introduced herself and shared her background as an advocate and Medford resident.

items.title: Impact of Roe v. Wade Decision in Massachusetts
items.summary: Laura Rótolo discussed the overturning of Roe v. Wade, noting that while the Roe Act protects abortion access in Massachusetts, efforts remain necessary to support providers and out-of-state patients.

items.title: Bodily Autonomy and Economic Impacts
items.summary: The hosts and guest discussed bodily autonomy, the missing analysis of women's economic self-determination in the Supreme Court opinion, and concerns surrounding rape exceptions.

items.title: Action Steps and Future Legal Risks
items.summary: Laura Rótolo recommended supporting local abortion funds, establishing a long-term strategy for reproductive freedom, and warned of potential future rulings targeting LGBTQ rights and contraception.

items.title: Conclusion and Resources
items.summary: Danielle Balocca concluded the episode and directed listeners to the show notes for advocacy resources and contact information.
